title: Concept: Operating-system command executed from a MATLAB string in matlab — review required
description: In matlab, system hands a string to the shell. MATLAB scripts often process filenames and identifiers read from data files, so the string can contain text the analyst did not type. Shell metacharacters in that text are interpreted, which turns a data file into a command source.
applicability: matlab analysis pipelines that shell out to external tools.
risk: Command execution with the analyst or service identity; HIGH severity.
